issue.title: test_pre_expand_parallel_no_embedded_workflows still asserts step identity after always-mark pre-render change
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `tests/test_workflow_executor_parallel.py::test_pre_expand_parallel_no_embedded_workflows`

Proposed by sase-1t3.11.1.5 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the
sase-1t3.11.1 land agent.

Deterministic failure on master 81e124eca8 (focused ToolRun
0d6a75910afff376dea8f37ff09f9581, `sase tool run test -- tests/test_workflow_executor_parallel.py ...`):

```
>       assert modified[1] is nested_steps[1]
E       AssertionError: assert WorkflowStep(name='step_b', agent='Plain prompt with no refs', ...) is WorkflowStep(name='step_b', ...)
tests/test_workflow_executor_parallel.py:206: AssertionError
```

Root cause: 4b9513e3f4 ("feat(macro): finish command-substitution provenance
landing", closed epic sase-1tc.1.1) intentionally changed
`ParallelMixin._pre_expand_parallel_embedded_workflows` in
`src/sase/macro/workflow_executor_parallel.py` to **always** deep-copy prompt
steps and `mark_step_pre_rendered(...)` them with stored directives ("Always mark
pre-rendered, even when bytes are unchanged: the rendered step must skip source
passes on its later preparation"). Before that commit, a prompt step whose
expansion was byte-identical was returned as the same object, which is what the
test still asserts with `is`. The production behavior is the intended contract;
the test is stale.

Fix: update the test to assert the new contract instead of identity -- the bash
step still passes through as the same object, the prompt step is a distinct copy
whose `agent` text is unchanged and which is marked pre-rendered (and carries the
extracted directives), and `collected == []`. Do not revert the always-mark
behavior.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails deterministically: sase-1t3.11.1.5 reproduced it on its clean base via stash, and the land agent reproduced it again on master 81e124eca8 (ToolRun 0d6a75910afff376dea8f37ff09f9581). The cause is a code change in 4b9513e3f4 that always deep-copies prompt steps, so the identity assertion can never pass.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1t3.11.1.5 as a clean-base failure; the sase-1t3.11.1 land agent reproduced it on master 81e124eca8 and traced it to 4b9513e3f4's intentional always-copy behavior, so the stale test needs updating.

payload.description: Closed epic whose 4b9513e3f4 landing introduced the always-copy pre-render behavior that made this test stale

payload.entry: Caused by epic sase-1tc (4b9513e3f4, sase-1tc.1.1 always-mark pre-render) and already fixed inside the same epic: 558fbd127f (sase-1tc.3.1.2) rewrote tests/test_workflow_executor_parallel.py::test_pre_expand_parallel_no_embedded_workflows to assert the new contract (bash step passes through by identity; prompt step is a distinct copy with unchanged agent text; collected == []), with no revert of always-mark. Verified by sase-1tc.land at master afb070580a: the identity assertion at the old line 206 is gone; later full checks (e.g. ToolRun f901dd4e9b90438ba51eab179fd85144, exit 0) did not report this node.
